document_role: Register-book copy of communicated paper, not separately inspected Journal Book meeting minutes or authenticated autograph.

images.description: Opening page with overlapping plate reverse, partly concealing text.
Neighboring Latin text and attached annotated engraving; cover piece overlaps mechanism and hair-frame area crossed.
Same opening page with overlay moved; sending and reading statements, brass-box description and internal drawing visible.

Sixty threads/divisions and hundred-part dial; cover/tube figure references and tube description.

findings.finding: Register text attributes contrivance and sending to Richard Towneley, description to Hooke, and its Society reading to November14,1667. Sending is a documentary report, not a shipment receipt or object authentication.

Copied Towneley letter is introduced as read July25,1667; distinguish this reading date from March25 composition heading in S296 and May1667 S294 print. No physical copy production date authenticated.

findings.locator: image2 p226 attached engraving versus S295 plate
findings.finding: Shared Fig1 mechanism, telescope and support arrangement. Visible added cover piece across mechanism, crossed hair-frame area and altered figure numbers: tube numbered3 and rest4, versus S295 tube4/rest5. Maker, date and purpose of physical interventions unknown.

Register text identifies second figure as cover, third as tube mounting and fourth as rest, consistent in broad numbering with altered engraving. S295 print separately explains third hair-frame figure, fourth tube and fifth rest. Selected comparison only, not full collation.
Hundred-part dial and sixty linear threads/divisions repeat nominal6000 increments across stated span; no measured precision or calibrated6000partsperfoot inferred.

Towneley account repeats Gascoigne priority/possession reports, local watchmaker assistance and angular-use precision claims; shared letter lineage, not independent corroboration or identified craftsman.
Two delivery views of p227 with overlay moved; eight canvases span seven visible numbered pages226-232. Different views are not separate manuscripts.

date_roles.calendar_conversion: None: historical labels retained; distribution/entry production dates not authenticated.

inspection: All eight delivery surfaces visually inspected. Selected text, figure numbering and engraving comparison; no full diplomatic transcription or physical authentication. Neighboring Latin article not evidence for instrument.
limits: Register Book Original is an archival series label, not proof of autograph authorship or independent testimony.
No shipment receipt, object identity, manufacture dimensions or raw accuracy trial.
No authenticated intervention sequence, editor identity or motive for altered engraving.
Printed issue label, reported reading and composition date are distinct; mismatch alone does not establish chronology fabrication.
Letter repetition and drawings remain dependent sources.
No ancient recovery, independent review or global catastrophe established.
next_test: Inspect original Journal Book entries for July11/25 and November7/14,1667, then correspondence and shipment records for the actual instrument. Identify who altered the engraving and when; preserve unknowns if inaccessible.
